Requirement You have an Ocular-slot cyber-augment with a targeting or rangefinder benefit.

The optic's been retuned to flag a Hot Load the instant the charge builds. On any turn you've spent a Hot Load, ignore the range penalty for the first range increment beyond your weapon's first on your remaining Strikes that turn. This doesn't extend the optic's own listed benefits — it just makes them fire early when the shot matters most.
